name: s3Copy
syntax: s3Copy(srcBucket, srcObject, trgBucket [, trgObject, acl, accessKeyId, secretKey, host])
description: Copies an object from one S3 (or S3-compatible) bucket to another (or to a different key in the same bucket).

params.name: trgObject
params.description: The destination object key. Defaults to the source object key.

params.name: acl
params.description: Object ACL to apply to the copy (accepted for compatibility; not enforced).

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: Inline AWS access key id. Overrides credentials from Application.cfc and environment variables.

params.name: host
params.description: Inline endpoint URL for S3-compatible providers (e.g. Cloudflare R2, MinIO).

examples.title: Copy an object to another bucket
examples.description: Copies the object, keeping the same key in the target bucket.
